spans.s: mf(आ)n. not one, more than one, various, manifold, numerous, many (also pl.), Yājñ.; Mn. &c.
&c. See p. 523, col. 3.
नैक—चर mf(ई)n. going in troops, gregarious (animal), BhP.
नैक—दृश् m. ‘many-eyed’, N. of a son of Viśvāmitra, MBh.
नैक—द्रव्योच्चय-वत् mfn. furnished with plenty of various goods, ib.
नैक—धर्म m. pl. several properties, Kāvyād.
नैक—धा ind. manifoldly, in various ways or parts, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
नैक—पुट mfn. showing many rents or gaps, torn (cloud), Var.
नैक—पृष्ठ m. pl. ‘many-backed’, N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. ˚ष्ट), VP.
नैक—भावाश्रय mfn. ‘not abiding in one condition’, changeable, fickle, unsteady, MW.
नैक—भेद mfn. of many kinds, various, manifold, L.
नैक—माय mfn. using many artifices or stratagems, MBh.
नैक—मुख mfn. many-faced, Bcar.
नैक—रूप mf(आ)n. multiform, various, R.
नैक—र्षि m. (for -ऋषि) N. of a man
pl. his family, Pravar.
नैक—वर्ण mfn. many-coloured, MBh.
नैक—विकल्प mfn. manifold, various, Daś.
नैक—विध mfn. id., Var.
नैक—शस् ind. repeatedly, often, Var.; Kāv.
नैक—शस्त्र-मय mf(ई)n. consisting of various missiles (rain), R.
नै˚कात्मन् mfn. of manifold nature (Śiva), Śivag.
नै—कटिक mfn. near, neighbouring, Hcar.; Bhaṭṭ. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 4, 73).
नै—कट्य n. nearness, neighbourhood, Kathās.
नै—कषी f. N. of Rāvaṇa's mother, AgP. (cf. नि-कष).
नै—कषेय m. a Rākṣasa (v.l. ˚सेय).
नै—कृतिक (Mn.; MBh. &c.) mfn. dishonest, fallacious, low, vile.
नै—कृतिन् (Var.) mfn. dishonest, fallacious, low, vile.

etym.s: fr. नैकती f. N. of a village in the north of India

spans.s: , Pāṇ. iv, 2, 110 g. पलद्य्-आदि.
